args.sql: SELECT * FROM statuses ORDER BY status;

SELECT * FROM links WHERE relation='blocks' AND valid_from <= TIMESTAMP '2021-07-07 05:22' AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > TIMESTAMP '2021-07-07 05:22') AND recorded_at <= TIMESTAMP '2021-07-07 05:22' AND (superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at > TIMESTAMP '2021-07-07 05:22');

WITH t AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2021-07-07 05:22' AS ts),
bl AS (
  SELECT src, dst FROM links, t
  WHERE relation='blocks' AND valid_from <= ts AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > ts)
    AND recorded_at <= ts AND (superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at > ts)
),
st AS (
  SELECT issue_key, value, valid_from, valid_to, recorded_at, superseded_at, event_type FROM field_versions, t
  WHERE field='status' AND valid_from <= ts AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > ts)
    AND recorded_at <= ts AND (superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at > ts)
)
SELECT bl.src, bl.dst, s1.value AS src_status, s2.value AS dst_status
FROM bl
LEFT JOIN st s1 ON s1.issue_key = bl.src
LEFT JOIN st s2 ON s2.issue_key = bl.dst
ORDER BY bl.src, bl.dst;

SELECT issue_key, value, valid_from, valid_to, recorded_at, superseded_at, event_type
FROM field_versions
WHERE issue_key IN ('PROJQUAY-271','PROJQUAY-1495','PROJQUAY-1690','PROJQUAY-2084','PROJQUAY-2085','PROJQUAY-2088','PROJQUAY-508','PROJQUAY-288','PROJQUAY-302','PROJQUAY-253','PROJQUAY-303','PROJQUAY-258','PROJQUAY-490','PROJQUAY-503','PROJQUAY-54')
  AND field='status'
ORDER BY issue_key, valid_from;

WITH t AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2021-07-07 05:22' AS ts),
cur AS (
  SELECT issue_key, value FROM field_versions, t
  WHERE field='status' AND valid_from <= ts AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > ts)
    AND recorded_at <= ts AND (superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at > ts)
),
bl AS (
  SELECT src, dst FROM links, t
  WHERE relation='blocks' AND valid_from <= ts AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > ts)
    AND recorded_at <= ts AND (superseded_at IS NULL OR superseded_at > ts)
)
SELECT DISTINCT bl.dst AS blocked_issue
FROM bl
JOIN issues i ON i.key = bl.dst AND i.project='PROJQUAY'
LEFT JOIN cur d ON d.issue_key = bl.dst
LEFT JOIN cur s ON s.issue_key = bl.src
WHERE COALESCE(d.value,'') NOT IN ('Closed','Resolved')
  AND COALESCE(s.value,'') NOT IN ('Closed','Resolved')
  AND s.issue_key IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1;

WITH t AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2021-07-07 05:22' AS ts),
active_links AS (
  SELECT l.src AS blocker, l.dst AS blocked
  FROM links l, t
  WHERE l.relation = 'blocks'
    AND l.valid_from <= t.ts AND (l.valid_to IS NULL OR l.valid_to > t.ts)
    AND l.recorded_at <= t.ts AND (l.superseded_at IS NULL OR l.superseded_at > t.ts)
),
status_at AS (
  SELECT f.issue_key, f.value
  FROM field_versions f, t
  WHERE f.field = 'status'
    AND f.valid_from <= t.ts AND (f.valid_to IS NULL OR f.valid_to > t.ts)
    AND f.recorded_at <= t.ts AND (f.superseded_at IS NULL OR f.superseded_at > t.ts)
),
done_set AS (SELECT issue_key FROM status_at WHERE value IN ('Closed','Resolved'))
SELECT DISTINCT a.blocked AS issue, a.blocker, s_blocked.value AS issue_status, s_blocker.value AS blocker_status
FROM active_links a
